Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: It misapplied the verb’s argument structure and case marking. Since “Maktay” functions like “is pleasing to,” the experiencer (“I”) should be the object (accusative “Mato”) and the liked item (“apples”) should be the subject (nominative “Apple”), in V-O-S order: “Maktay Mato Apple.” Instead, it produced “Maktay Zapple Mato,” wrongly making apples the direct object and using “Mato” in the subject position, contradicting both the provided semantics and cases.
